decision: held: the two randomized trials (22486722 OA, J Agric Food Chem 2012; 31221944 facial skin, Altern Ther Health Med 2019) have no open full text, so their methods, regimens and primary outcomes cannot be verified as Dr. Pham requested; the only open source (22956862) is an uncontrolled open-label pilot, approved without credit.
summary: 22956862: 29 women enrolled, 26 completed an open-label 12-week pilot of BioCell Collagen 1 g/day (two 500 mg capsules, each 300 mg hydrolyzed collagen II, 100 mg chondroitin sulfate, 50 mg hyaluronic acid), with within-group skin dryness and wrinkle improvements; it cannot establish efficacy. The OA and controlled skin RCTs are paywalled, so the record stays held. Isolated-component attribution remains rejected.

identity.standardization: Each 500 mg capsule: hydrolyzed collagen type II 300 mg, depolymerized chondroitin sulfate 100 mg, hyaluronic acid 50 mg, remaining 50 mg other natural components

population.description: 29 women enrolled and 26 completed the uncontrolled open-label skin-aging pilot.

study_contexts.study_design: Prospective uncontrolled, single-arm, open-label pilot intervention; 29 enrolled and 26 completed; before/after observations without randomization or placebo.

dose.administration_frequency: One 500 mg capsule in the morning and one in the evening.
dose.reported_regimen: 1000 mg total BioCell Collagen per day for 84 days; no isolated-component efficacy attribution.

normalization.basis: Reported study-material daily dose, not a universal threshold or equivalence to other preparation.

source_provenance.location: Methods (study design: 29 enrolled, 26 completed; visits 0, 6, 12 weeks; Camay soap run-in; supplement composition 500 mg capsule); Results

co_therapies: No skin-active topical/systemic antiaging treatments during the trial; cleanser Camay use remains a cointervention/confound.

outcomes.name: Dryness and wrinkle changes from baseline

limitations: The retained full article does not designate a primary outcome/endpoint; recorded hierarchy not_reported. This is a reporting limitation, not invented primary status or completion of any separate approval.
Uncontrolled intervention: within-group observations cannot establish placebo-controlled efficacy; scoring eligibility remains false and all other scope/review holds remain.
Returned decision A004: isolated-component attribution (collagen, chondroitin or hyaluronic acid alone) rejected.
